english: Welcome to the world of Mu.;We have been waiting for a hero like you to arrive and put a stop to the chaos brought on to the Mu realm by Kundun.
zh-CN: 欢迎来到奇迹世界。;我们一直等待像你这样的勇士，终结昆顿给奇迹大陆带来的混乱。

english: Continue listening.
zh-CN: 继续听下去。

english: However, journeys such as this are bound to be perilous.;If you wish, we can provide you with a simple tutorial. What do you say?
zh-CN: 然而，这样的旅程必定充满危险。;如果你愿意，我们可以提供简单的新手教学。你意下如何？

english: A tutorial?;I look forward to it!
zh-CN: 新手教学？;我很期待！

english: Tutorials are for children. Turn down the offer.
zh-CN: 新手教学是给孩子的。拒绝帮助。

english: It won't take up too much of your time. I'll simply explain basic controls and hunting techniques.;Are you sure you don't want our help?
zh-CN: 不会占用你太多时间。我只会简单介绍基本操作和打怪技巧。;你确定不需要我们的帮助吗？

english: I have plenty of experience.;To each his own!
zh-CN: 我已经很有经验了。;每个人都有自己的选择！

english: How can I turn him down...?;Alright, let's give it a try!
zh-CN: 怎能拒绝他的好意呢……;好吧，试试看！

english: I'm glad we can help. We aren't difficult to find.;Simply look for and talk to the Shadow Phantom Soldier in any of the towns.
zh-CN: 很高兴能够帮到你。我们并不难找。;在各个城镇找到幻影导师，与他交谈即可。

english: I regret we can't be of any help to you.;Here, at least take this present. I hope, the next time we meet, a great warrior stands before my eyes.;Enjoy your time out there.
zh-CN: 很遗憾没能帮到你。;至少请收下这份礼物。希望下次见面时，你已成为一名出色的勇士。;祝你旅途愉快。

english: I respect your decision to go on this journey.;Allow me to teach you a few simple but essential things you need to know before your adventure in MU begins.
zh-CN: 我尊重你踏上旅程的决定。;在奇迹冒险开始前，让我教你一些简单却必不可少的知识。

english: ...This is Noria, the kingdom of Elves! So this is where my adventure begins.;How exhilarating!
zh-CN: ……这里是弓箭手的王国仙踪林！我的冒险就从这里开始。;真令人兴奋！

english: ...This is Lorencia, the kingdom of Dark Wizards and Dark Knights! So this is where my adventure begins.;Excellent! My adventure begins!
zh-CN: ……这里是魔法师与剑士的王国勇者大陆！我的冒险就从这里开始。;太好了！冒险开始了！

english: ...This is Elveland, the kingdom of Summoners! So this is where my adventure begins.;How exhilarating!
zh-CN: ……这里是召唤术师的王国幻术园！我的冒险就从这里开始。;真令人兴奋！

english: It's nice to meet you.;May I ask who you are?
zh-CN: 很高兴认识你。;请问你是谁？

english: Alright! Let's get started with the tutorial.
zh-CN: 好！让我们开始新手教学吧。

english: Let's start with something simple.;Close your quest window and either press C or click on the Character (C) button located on the bottom right of your screen to launch the Character Stats window.
zh-CN: 先从简单的操作开始。;关闭任务窗口，按 C 键或点击屏幕右下方的角色（C）按钮，打开角色属性窗口。

english: Now, press the I button or click on the Inventory (I/V) button located on the bottom right to open your Inventory window.
zh-CN: 现在按 I 键，或点击屏幕右下方的背包（I/V）按钮，打开背包窗口。

english: Press Q, W, E to use the items such as healing potion, mana potion, antidote, alcohol or town portal scroll registered under those keys.
zh-CN: 按 Q、W、E 键，可使用绑定在对应快捷键上的治疗药水、魔法药水、解毒剂、酒或回城卷轴。

english: Vault usage fee is deducted from your inventory according to your level.
zh-CN: 使用仓库的费用根据角色等级从背包中扣除。

english: Use the lock function on your vault to protect it.
zh-CN: 使用仓库上锁功能保护你的物品。

english: Point the cursor on the skill button and press ctrl+number key to set hotkey.
zh-CN: 将鼠标移到技能按钮上，按 Ctrl＋数字键设置快捷键。

english: Press space bar to collect loot.
zh-CN: 按空格键拾取物品。

english: To combat normally, left click on monster.
zh-CN: 鼠标左键点击怪物进行普通攻击。

english: To use skill during combat, right click on monster.
zh-CN: 鼠标右键点击怪物施放技能。

english: Right click on scrolls or orbs to master the noted skills.
zh-CN: 鼠标右键点击技能卷轴或技能石，即可学习对应技能。

english: To use skills or magic, right click on monster.
zh-CN: 鼠标右键点击怪物，使用技能或魔法。

english: The command (trade, party, whisper, etc.) system is accessible by pressing the 'D' key.
zh-CN: 按 D 键打开指令菜单，可使用交易、组队、密语等功能。

english: Click shortcut key T to check the quest information.
zh-CN: 按 T 键查看任务信息。

english: Wearing a level +5 or above boots allows you to run.
zh-CN: 穿戴强化等级为 +5 或以上的靴子即可奔跑。

english: When poisoned, you can cure yourself by using the antidote.
zh-CN: 中毒后可使用解毒剂解除中毒。

english: Using the 'town portal scroll' will transport you to the nearest town or safe area.
zh-CN: 使用回城卷轴可返回最近的城镇或安全区。

english: To save a screenshot in your Mu folder, press the 'Print Screen' key.
zh-CN: 按 Print Screen 键截图，图片将保存在奇迹客户端目录中。

english: Item's performance level decreases when the durability decreases.
zh-CN: 物品耐久度降低时，其性能也会下降。

english: To use the saved chatting macro, press Alt+number.
zh-CN: 按 Alt＋数字键使用已保存的聊天宏。

english: To fix your weapon or armor, go to the weapon merchants in town.
zh-CN: 前往城镇的武器商人处修理武器或防具。

english: The supplementary magic of the Elf can be used by clicking the name in the party window.
zh-CN: 点击组队窗口中的角色名称，可对其施放弓箭手的辅助魔法。

english: Click shortcut key T to check the quest information.
zh-CN: 按 T 键查看任务信息。
